finalLens.title: The Unset Time.
finalLens.intro: You pause over the unresolved detail in a warm message, asking how its promise will appear in follow-through.
finalLens.pull_quote: For you, a promise earns its tenderness by remaining visible in the ordinary rhythm of the week.
finalLens.deeper_read: Loyalty makes you attentive to whether closeness can hold its shape after the reassuring moment passes. You naturally offer steadiness, yet under pressure that same commitment can leave your own need for a clear edge unspoken.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for yourself accepting reassurance without asking which part of the plan will happen when.
finalLens.move: Ask for one timing detail about the plan, then leave the rest of the exchange intact.

finalLens.watch_for: Watch for your hand reaching back to the phone after one maintenance loop has already ended.
finalLens.move: Keep the phone out of reach for the next thirty minutes of the quiet hour.

finalLens.title: Put Ownership Forward.
finalLens.intro: Careful structure reaches its limit when a deadline leaves the next handoff without a visible owner.
finalLens.pull_quote: The thoughtful result becomes usable when its next owner is visible to everyone in the meeting.

finalLens.watch_for: Watch for revising handoff details after the meeting instead of identifying who carries the deadline.
finalLens.move: Before the meeting closes, identify one person responsible for the next handoff and deadline.
